methodologyNotes: Dataset covers ten drip/automatic coffee makers (not espresso) spanning entry-level to premium segments, selected for high US search volume and active retail presence as of mid-2026. Primary sources were official manufacturer product pages (Moccamaster, Breville, OXO, Bonavita, Zojirushi, SharkNinja, Hamilton Beach, Cuisinart, Braun, Cafe) supplemented by major specialty retailers (Whole Latte Love, Williams Sonoma) and major retailers (Amazon, Best Buy, Bloomingdale's). Adversarial re-verification 2026-06-15: each priceUsd, releaseDate, and headline spec was re-checked against the official manufacturer page where reachable plus a second independent source. Brew temperature values are in °F; capacity is in US cups (5 oz per cup per convention); sca_certified is a boolean reflecting current SCA Home Brewer Program certification; warranty_years reflects the US limited warranty stated by the manufacturer. Unverifiable specs were set to null rather than guessed. All prices are US MSRP or current listed retail price in USD. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Fellow Aiden Precision Coffee Maker
products.priceNote: Whole Latte Love regular price = sale price $399.95 (same $399.95 listed at Prima Coffee); the cited retailer page does not explicitly label it MSRP.
products.provenance: The official Fellow product page confirms the exact model ("Aiden Precision Electric Coffee Maker – Fellow") but renders its specs behind a JavaScript country-selector, so all numeric specs were taken verbatim from the Whole Latte Love listing for the same model: Carafe Type "Thermal", 1.5 L / 50.7 oz capacity described as "brew 1 cup or 10" (10 US cups at 5 oz/cup), "Programmable Brew Recipes / App Control", and a stated "2-Year Parts and Labor Warranty"; price $399.95 (regular = sale) is shown there and again on Prima Coffee. Amazon's listing for the identical model independently corroborates single-serve-to-10-cup capacity, thermal carafe, and the 2-year standard warranty (Fellow adds a 3rd year on registration); the Aiden is not marketed as SCA-certified and has only a removable water tank with no built-in water filter, so both booleans are false. brew_temp_f is left null — Prima Coffee lists a 122–210°F temperature range, but that page is not one of the two cited URLs, so under the verbatim rule the value is not asserted rather than risk a value the gate cannot re-verify on the cited pages.

products.name: Ratio Six (Series 2)

products.name: Breville Precision Brewer Glass
products.priceNote: Whole Latte Love listed regular/sale price $299.95 for the BDC400BSS; Breville's official page marks the model discontinued, so this is the last retail price. No separate US MSRP was stated verbatim on any fetched page.
products.provenance: The official Breville US page confirms this exact model — "the Breville Precision Brewer® Glass" (BDC400) with a glass carafe, 60 oz capacity, Gold Cup standard preset and a Thermocoil heating system with PID Control; the page marks the model discontinued and publishes no specific brew-temperature range, so brew_temp_f is null. Whole Latte Love (BDC400BSS, SKU 26478) corroborates the identity and states the price $299.95 (regular/sale), Carafe Type: Glass, 60 oz volume, SCA-certified Gold Cup brewing, and a 2 Year Limited Warranty. Capacity 12 cups follows the 60 oz carafe under the catalog's 5 oz/cup convention and appears verbatim as "12-Cup" on the fetched Williams Sonoma page; a programmable auto-start timer and a release year were not stated on the cited pages, so both are null, and the accessory list (coffee filters plus a water-hardness test strip, no charcoal filter) supports water_filter=false.

products.name: Balmuda The Brew
products.priceNote: BALMUDA USA official store price $699.00 USD (listed verbatim as "Black - $699.00 USD" / "$699.00"). The Amazon US-version listing showed "No featured offers available" at access, so no retailer price was corroborated.
products.provenance: Official BALMUDA USA product page confirmed the price ($699.00 USD) and the exact US-version model: 120V AC / 1450W / 60Hz, stainless-steel double-walled vacuum-sealed carafe (approx. 17 fl. oz.), open-drip method, and three brew modes (Regular, Strong, Iced). The Amazon "US Version" listing corroborated model identity — matching dimensions (11.7"D x 5.5"W x 14.9"H), 120V, and the approx. 17 fl. oz. carafe — confirming this is the 120V US version of "The Brew" (K06A), not the Japan 100V or Korea 220V variant. carafe_type set to "thermal" (double-walled vacuum stainless, per dataset convention); brew_temp_f left null because the pages state only "precise temperature control" with no numeric °F; capacity_cups null (carafe rated in fl. oz., no cup count stated); warranty_years and release null (not stated on either fetched page); programmable, sca_certified, and water_filter false as none are claimed by the manufacturer.
